concept_options.title: What If You Fired Everyone and Hired AI?
concept_options.why_this_works: The film's own title and the writer's pick; pairs with thumbnail a (WHO EATS?)
concept_options.visual_approach: Your diner at night across the road from the car plant (its lit sheds and chimney through the long window): you large at the left, head 34% of the frame height, mustard head, teal scarf, white apron, arms thrown wide, a fan of cash in your raised hand, eyes wide, mouth open, stunned and thrilled; behind the counter four steel robot cooks with screen faces (two happy arcs), each with a burger flipped high off its spatula; a pile of plated burgers nobody is eating along the front counter; four empty teal stools. Three candidates a, b, c differ only in the tag (WHO EATS?, ANYONE?, UH OH.); drawn in code, brand/thumbs/aitrap; K3-K11 pass (thumb-checks.json). The film opens on this frame (0:00-0:08) and stages it again at 4:10
concept_options.hook: A spatula clang; four steel cooks flip four burgers onto plates nobody takes; you at the left with a fan of cash, forty empty stools, the car plant lit across the road. "What if you fired everyone and hired AI?" Then, six weeks earlier: your cook is sick again, and an app you never installed says: hire any job, no wage.

selected_concept.rationale: Owner's pick at G1, 2026-11-16, in chat: "Pair A + WHO EATS?". Title A (What If You Fired Everyone and Hired AI?) with thumbnail a (WHO EATS?), the writer's recommendation.

stages.approach: Packaging (G1, 2026-11-15): three titles, three one-variable thumbnails drawn in code (brand/thumbs/aitrap), the beat outline on the template spine opening on the thumbnail's frame then a performed skit; claims.md (28 rows; the paper's six contested) started at G1; one G1 room round (story editor, claims check)

script.md, sequel.md and chapters on the template (rules/story.md #1-#22, 155 wpm, about 9 min), exciting not sad; the free local narration (voice B narrator, local cast voices) and a 720p first cut before G2; a score cue per section and an ambience bed per set; the G2 room; omni qc story_script must pass
Picture lock: cut, key shot (the thumbnail frame), text, music and mix; the paid voice A/B only if the owner asks
The owner watches at 1x with cold viewers
publish.md and upload.yaml; private upload only when the owner asks

line_items.notes: Free and local. G1 made no paid provider call: the thumbnails are drawn in code; the writer ran on the owner's Claude subscription (claude -p, one call) and the room used today's capped calls (story editor, claims check)
